fields.organization: Humanitarian Country Team, Republic of Tamsaria

decisions.decision: The Humanitarian Coordinator will submit a request to the Emergency Relief Coordinator to activate clusters for health, water sanitation and hygiene, shelter, food security, protection and logistics.
A flash appeal of US$ 62.0 million is launched on the basis of the rapid assessment.
Unassigned health gaps G-01 (Hadar) and G-04 (Bel Ravi) are taken to member organizations for volunteers.

escalations: Health: no psychosocial support partner in Bel Ravi (G-04)
fields.securityNote: Members agreed to share incident reports and alerts through the inter-agency security channel. Participation does not make the UN responsible for any organization's staff security.
